source_refs.note: 3- Nicotine: a main subheading of 15.7.2 Use and Abuse of Drugs, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 48-49.

blocks.text: Nicotine bohat nasha-awar drug hai jo tambakoo ki cheezon, jaise cigarettes, cigars aur baghair dhuein ke tambakoo, mein hoti hai. Is ka istemal lat aur dependence ke saath saath kai jismani aur zehni nuqsanat laata hai, jaise saans ke masail, cancers, dil aur khoon ki nalyon ki bimari (cardiovascular disease) aur zehni bimariyan.
